app.name: FlickerTalk
app.tagline: The most private chat. Your messages live on your phone.

chats.emptyHint: Show your code or scan theirs to start

chat.cannotRecord: Can't record: the microphone is not allowed
chat.cannotRecordHere: Can't record here: this phone's browser has no recorder
chat.cannotTakePhoto: Can't take a photo: the camera is not available or not allowed

calls.speaker: Speaker
calls.cameraDenied: The camera isn't allowed. Allow it for FlickerTalk in your phone's Settings.
calls.cameraFailed: The camera couldn't start. The call goes on as voice.
calls.videoUnavailable: Video isn't available on this call

welcome.fromOld: I have FlickerTalk on another phone
welcome.title: Welcome
welcome.identityCreated: Your identity was created on this phone
welcome.noAccount: No account, no phone number, no email
welcome.name: Your name
welcome.nameHint: Contacts see it when they add you. Optional.

addContact.title: Add contact
addContact.myCodeHint: Let them scan this code, or share the link
addContact.scanHint: Point the camera at their code
addContact.invalid: That is not a FlickerTalk contact link

scanner.cameraDenied: Camera access is off, so the code can't be read. Allow it next time, or paste the link instead.
scanner.cameraBlocked: Camera access is off for FlickerTalk. Turn it on in Settings, or paste the link instead.

contact.verifyHint: Compare both codes when you are together
contact.reportEvidence: Include their last messages as evidence
contact.reportHint: Opens an email to FlickerTalk. Only what you send leaves this phone.
contact.name: Name on this phone
contact.deleteHint: This deletes the contact and their conversation from this phone.

move.scanThis: On your old phone: Settings → Move to a new phone, and scan this code.
move.noKey: The code only pairs the two phones: your keys travel directly, encrypted.
move.everything: Your identity, contacts and messages move to the new phone
move.erased: This phone will be erased afterwards. Files you sent or received stay behind.
move.keepClose: Keep both phones open and close together
move.sent: Moved. This phone is being erased
move.restarting: FlickerTalk starts again in a moment

blocked.title: Blocked
blocked.hint: Unblock them to write to them and get their messages and calls.

settings.title: Settings
settings.eraseHint: Removes this device from our server and deletes everything on this phone
settings.eraseFailed: This phone could not be erased. Try again.
settings.renewLinkHint: Whoever has your old link can no longer reach you; your contacts get the new one

hours.title: Hours
hours.note: Outside them, messages arrive in silence and calls do not ring

session.addContact: Add a contact to this session
session.empty: No contacts here yet. Add one with the QR button: it belongs to this session only.

plugins.title: Plugins
plugins.hint: Plugins run inside FlickerTalk. They start with nothing: you choose what each one may do, and you can take it back.
plugins.mayNotWrite: This tool may not write in the chat. Turn on “Write in the chat” for it in Settings → Plugins.
plugins.installFailed: The tool could not be installed. Check your connection and try again.
plugins.live: Talk to the same plugin on the other side of the chat
plugins.drive: Keep files in your own cloud
plugins.storageLarge: Keep a lot of data on this phone (up to 256 MB)
plugins.location: Your location, only when you ask

plan.hint: FlickerTalk is {price} a year, and free if you are under 21. The first year from the install is free for everyone. Without it you still receive and answer; starting a new conversation, calling and sending files need the subscription.
plan.hintYearly: FlickerTalk is a yearly subscription, and free if you are under 21. The first year from the install is free for everyone. Without it you still receive and answer; starting a new conversation, calling and sending files need the subscription.

trouble.not_on_sale: The subscription is not on sale yet.
trouble.store_unavailable: The Store is not answering. Try again later.
trouble.pending_approval: The purchase is waiting to be approved.
trouble.failed: The Store could not take the payment.

requests.title: Requests
requests.hint: They have your link. Nothing of theirs is downloaded and they cannot call until you accept.
requests.blockAsk: Block {name}? They will not be able to write to you or call you.

circle.title: Circle
circle.newHint: A small, closed group of your contacts. Nobody outside it, not even our server, knows it exists. Messages only, for now.
circle.name: Circle name
circle.left: You are no longer in this circle
circle.noOneToInvite: Every contact of yours is in it already
circle.noHistory: Whoever joins later does not see what was said before

backup.title: Backup
backup.noneHint: Keep a sealed copy of this phone in your own Google Drive. Everything is encrypted here before it leaves; Google sees sealed files, and we see nothing.
backup.empty: Your cloud has no FlickerTalk drive yet
backup.emptyHint: Setting it up makes a key on this phone, locked with a recovery phrase you choose.
backup.outdated: Your cloud has a drive from an earlier version of the app
backup.outdatedHint: Set it up again with a recovery phrase. What it held can no longer be opened.
backup.phraseHint: It opens your backup on a new phone. Without it, nobody can recover your account: we never see it and cannot get it back for you.
backup.phraseMismatch: The two phrases are not the same
backup.notSameGoogle: Keep it somewhere safe, but not in this same Google account.
backup.phraseChanged: Done: from now on only the new phrase opens your drive
backup.wrongPhrase: That phrase does not open this drive
backup.retryAt: Too many wrong phrases on this phone. Try again after {when}.
backup.locked: This cloud has a drive from another phone
backup.unlockHint: Type its recovery phrase to open it here.
backup.restoreAsk: Replace everything on this phone with the backup? The app starts again.
backup.forget: Forget this cloud on this phone
backup.forgetHint: Your files stay in your cloud, sealed. You will need the recovery phrase to open them again.
backup.sees: Your cloud sees how many sealed files there are, their sizes and dates. Never their names or contents.

games.removeWarning: Removing it deletes its saved games on this phone.
games.noContacts: Add a contact to play with
games.permissionsBody: This game talks to the other person's phone and can leave the result in the chat.
games.offline: No games to add right now. Check your connection and try again.
games.installFailed: The game could not be installed. Check your connection and try again.
games.live: Talk to the same game on the other person's phone

feedback.title: Suggest something
feedback.placeholder: What would you like FlickerTalk to have?
feedback.hint: It reaches us without your name or any identifier. We cannot reply. Do not write personal data.
feedback.tooMany: You have already sent several today. Try again tomorrow
feedback.failed: Could not send. Try again later
